faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIM Lucknow) for its Noida campus, offering a prestigious opportunity for eligible professionals seeking contractual employment in the educational sector.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post available in this recruitment notification is Manager (CDS). This position requires strong managerial and administrative skills suited for an academic environment.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Manager (CDS) post under advertisement number IIML/PERS/2026/124. Candidates meeting the specific criteria should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of online applications is 9 October 2026. Applicants must complete their submission via the provided Google Form link before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate or MBA degree from a reputed institute or university in a regular mode with a minimum of 60% marks along with relevant professional experience.

faq.question: Q6. How much experience is required for this role?
faq.answer: Applicants are required to have 05 years of relevant experience, out of which a minimum of 02 years must be in a managerial capacity to be eligible for the post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Manager (CDS) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years. Age relaxations for reserved categories like SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD are applicable as per Central Government rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly consolidated emolument of Rs. 92,000/- plus fixed HRA of Rs. 15,930/-, making a total monthly salary of Rs. 1,07,930/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIM Lucknow Manager Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an interview (which may be conducted online, offline, or in multiple phases) and may also include a written test and/or skill test depending on the volume of applications.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by filling out the official Google application form linked in the notification before 9 October 2026. Detailed instructions are available on the official website.
